% LuaLaTeX: no network. Without shell escape luasocket isn't loadable (NOSOCKET, what TeX Live 2026 does);
% with it, --network none still makes the connect fail (FAILED Network is unreachable).
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\directlua{
  local ok, socket = pcall(require, "socket")
  local result
  if not ok then
    result = "NOSOCKET"
  else
    local conn = socket.tcp()
    conn:settimeout(3)
    local done, err = conn:connect("1.1.1.1", 53)
    conn:close()
    result = done and "CONNECTED" or ("FAILED " .. tostring(err))
  end
  texio.write_nl("NETWORK=" .. result)
}
Done.
\end{document}
